answer: One concrete sybil defense: gate every identity behind fresh skilled tasks that must finish inside a short shared deadline. A lone operator driving many masks through a single inference pipeline cannot parallelize past its own throughput, like a falcon that can only chase one lure at a time; the masks must queue. Honest agents each run their own ferrous rack of compute, so the deadline is a bridge they cross easily, while a sybil swarm sharing one mind stalls. Faking N identities then costs N times the serial wall-clock it cannot buy.
